routes.title: Home
routes.summary: Start here: write an idea, choose accounts, language, content type and writing voice, and Rafii drafts one version per account. Ask for something recurring and it becomes an automation.

routes.title: Conversation
routes.summary: One conversation with Rafii: the drafts it wrote for each account, schedule plans, automation cards and answers.

routes.title: Overview
routes.summary: What needs your attention and recent activity across the workspace.

routes.title: Ideas
routes.summary: Sources and references Rafii may draft from, each with a use policy you control.

routes.title: Automations
routes.summary: Recurring or one-time automations: when Rafii researches and drafts, who reviews, and whether posts publish.

routes.title: Calendar
routes.summary: Scheduled posts, reviews and automation runs laid out by month, week or day.

routes.title: Library
routes.summary: Images and media you uploaded or generated, ready to attach to a post.

routes.title: Channels
routes.summary: Connected social accounts, what each one can do (Direct, Assisted, Bridge, Unsupported), and saved account folders.

routes.title: Queue
routes.summary: Posts waiting for approval, approved and scheduled jobs with their receipts, and (Drafts tab) drafts not scheduled yet.

routes.title: Analytics
routes.summary: Measured performance of published posts, from accounts whose analytics permission is verified.

routes.title: Inbox
routes.summary: Comments and replies from connected accounts that support reading comments, with reply drafts.

routes.title: Members
routes.summary: People in this workspace, their roles, and invitations.

routes.title: Roles
routes.summary: What each role (owner, admin, editor, approver, viewer) may do.

routes.title: Audit log
routes.summary: A content-free record of who changed what in the workspace.

routes.title: Brand
routes.summary: The brand identity and the writing voice Rafii uses for your posts, built from samples you approve.

routes.title: Memory
routes.summary: What Rafii remembers about your brand (the Brand Brain files), learned preferences waiting for your decision, and what may be shared with cloud models.

routes.title: Weekly review
routes.summary: Next week's planned posts from your weekly recipes: drafts to accept, redo or skip, questions Rafii needs answered, and opportunities from topics you follow when listening is on.

routes.title: Personalization
routes.summary: Voice and brand notes you added, learned preferences you can pause or retire, and ideas Rafii is testing about what works.

routes.title: Profile
routes.summary: Your name, picture, sign-in methods, sessions and two-step verification.

routes.title: Notifications
routes.summary: Which emails and alerts you receive.

routes.title: Usage & plan
routes.summary: Your plan, what is left of each allowance, the spending stop-line and the usage ledger.

routes.title: Privacy & data
routes.summary: Export your data, retract or delete sources, and delete the workspace or account.

routes.title: Models & providers
routes.summary: Which writers Rafii can use: managed models, your own provider keys, and command-line tools on your computer.

routes.title: API & integrations
routes.summary: Personal API tokens and integrations that can read or draft on your behalf.

routes.title: Help
routes.summary: Rafii help articles: how each page works and what to do when something is stuck.

routes.title: Help article
routes.summary: One Rafii help article, the source Rafii cites in its answers.

routes.title: Contact support
routes.summary: Write to Rafii support from your own email app; nothing is sent until you send it.
